HPRT-Mutation Assay

TK-Mutation Assay

1. Target cells and loci

-V79 cells come from a male Chinese Hamster (lung tissue)  
-CHO cells come from Chinese Hamster ovary tissue  
-hprt structure gene is located at the X-chromosome

-L5178Y TK \( ^{+/-} \) -3.7.2C, mouse lymphoma cell line

-heterozygous for the autosomal tk locus (chromosome 11)

2. Growth characteristics

*PDT (population doubling time)
-V79: 10-12 h
-CHO: 12-16 h
*high cloning efficiency
*adherent growing cells

\[
- 1 0 \pm 2 h
\]

*high cloning efficiency
*suspension growth

3. Metabolic activation

-external metabolising systems: freshly isolated hepatocytes, Aroclor 1254 induced rat liver S9 plus cofactors (1-10% S9)

-Aroclor 1254 induced rat liver S9 plus cofactors (1-10% S9) usually used as an external metabolising system

4. Spontaneous mutant frequency

-V79: cleansed cultures MF of solvent control is typically  \( 5 \times 10^{-6} \) 
-CHO: MF of the solvent controls:  \( 0-20 \times 10^{-6} \)

-freshly cleansed cultures: MF 20-100 x \(10^{-6}\)

5. Treatment

*Cell plating/Incubation time:
-V79: 1-2 x 10\( ^{6} \) cells for 2, 24 or 72 h
-CHO: 0.5-1.5 x 10\( ^{6} \) cells generally for 3 h

-6 x 10\( ^{6} \) cells for 4 h

*Expression time
-V79: 4-6 days
-CHO: 7-9 days

-2-3 days

6. Cloning

*Cloning efficiency in nonselective medium -V79: 100-200 cells/5 cm plate for 6-12 days -CHO: 500 cells/plate for 14-17 days

-in soft agar: 300-600 cells/plate for 9-12 days
-in microtiter plates: 1 cell/well for 14 days

*Selection in selective medium
-V79: 1 x 10\( ^{6} \) cells/15 cm plate for 6-12 days
-CHO: 2 x 10\( ^{5} \) or fewer cells/10 cm plate for 14-17 days

-in soft agar: 1.5-3 x \(10^{6}\) cells for 9-12 days -microtiter assay: 2000 cells/well for 14 days

-concentration of the selective agent 6-thioguanine: 10-60 μM

-concentration of trifluorothymidine (TFT): 1-5  \( \mu \) g/ml (3.4-17  \( \mu \) M)

7. Length of the assays

-V79: 15 to 26 days
-CHO: 26 to 34 days

-16 to 23 (25) days
